title: Senegal Country Climate and Development Report: Executive Summary
temporal_coverage: Observed socioeconomic vulnerability and modeled climate impacts through 2050
methodology: Executive summary reports CCDR climate and macroeconomic modeling results.
limitations: Only summary opened; inherited West Bank/Gaza and Madagascar footer references raise source-quality concerns.

title: Diagnostic sur le Financement des Risques Climatiques et de Catastrophes au Sénégal
temporal_coverage: Historical hazard impacts and forward climate-risk analysis in the 2024 diagnostic
methodology: World Bank disaster-risk financing diagnostic combines historical loss review and probabilistic risk analysis.
limitations: Historical event and modeled risk estimates use different methods and periods; the report notes data-quality dependence for modeled results.

title: Contribution Déterminée au Niveau National du Sénégal: Document approuvé – décembre 2020
organization: Republic of Senegal; submitted to the UNFCCC
temporal_coverage: Government NDC climate-risk projections and adaptation commitments through 2030
methodology: Government NDC summarizes observed climate impacts and modeled regional climate risks.
limitations: NDC projections are dated and should not be read as current observations or as evaluated results.

title: Don't blame it on ethnicity: The role of group identities and climate risks in farmer-herder relations in Senegal
organization: Journal of Peace Research; Wageningen University & Research
geographic_coverage: Ferlo Desert silvopastoral zone in Louga Region
temporal_coverage: Field data collected October-November 2022; article published November 2025.
methodology: Public-good experiment with 332 analyzed participants after five exclusions from 337;14 focus groups. Coordinator read the publisher DOI redirect.
limitations: Artificial collective-risk treatment and game cooperation are not observed climate impacts or violence; study municipalities are unnamed.

title: Senegal, Evaluation of Green Climate Fund Project: 2020-2024
temporal_coverage: R4 project implementation 2020-01-14 to 2024-10-14; evaluation conducted July 2024-February 2025.
methodology: WFP publisher summary of a decentralized, end-of-project evaluation; full evaluation methods were not accessible.
limitations: The publisher summary omits design details, sample, subgroup estimates and effect sizes; the linked evaluation PDF required JavaScript verification.

title: Strengthening adaptive and socio-economic capacities of women and youth in the village of Mbam through the Integrated Resilience Garden approach
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), SAGA 2
temporal_coverage: Project page lists start date 2024-09-06 and end date 2026-05-31, while still displaying status as active.
methodology: Official FAO project page describing local objectives, implementation partners and listed activities.
limitations: The page's displayed active status conflicts with its May 2026 end date; listed activities are not independently verified as completed outcomes.

title: Challenges to food security in a changing environment: a community-based participatory research study in Casamance, Senegal (West Africa)
temporal_coverage: Study field period not stated in the article; published 2026-03-31.
methodology: Mixed-method participatory study: 42 exploratory participants, then 234 agricultural interviewees across 13 communities.
limitations: Purposive sample from selected communities; partly self-reported and cross-sectional, limiting generalization.
